turns.exact_text: Was he recognized by the Choctaw tribal authorities as a Choctaw Indian?
Yes, that is what they tell me; I have heard them say he was.
Well, by the tribal authorities, I mean by act of council did they vote upon him and vote him in and make him a member?

turns.exact_text: Did he ever claim or receive any land in Mississippi as a beneficiary under article fourteen of the treaty of 1830?
I only heard him say that if he could come to the Indian Territory he would have a right here.
What do you know with reference to his having any land in Mississippi from the Government?
I don’t know anything at all.

follow_forward_sequence.sequence_note: The first answer reports remembered conditional speech attributed to Robert Bell. It is not Robert’s direct testimony and does not establish a claim, land receipt, travel, or what “right here” meant. The following answer separately limits Hugh’s knowledge of government land in Mississippi.
